exposure: Referral from primary to secondary care during labor
outcome: Neonatal outcomes (Apgar score, umbilical cord pH)
cohort: 600 pregnant women referred from primary to secondary care during labor
finding: Most women referred during labor had moderate risk indications and a high probability of spontaneous vaginal delivery, suggesting potential for continued care by trained primary care midwives.
mod_finding: Women referred from primary to secondary care during labor had a high probability of spontaneous vaginal delivery.
